title: GIFT CARD GIVEAWAY!
description: Facebook page: Two Tubbs  GIFT CARD GIVEAWAY!!  Giving away FOUR $25 gift cards to four random winners!  Gift cards from: Olive Garden, Texas Roadhouse, Red Lobster, and Starbucks!  Winners will be picked Friday, March 20th.  Go to our Facebook, two tubbs, for information.  https://m.facebook.com/Twotubbs/

asr.full_text: Hey guys, how's it going? Kellen from Two Tubs podcast that we have here on Facebook and YouTube. So what we're going to do to promote our Facebook and our YouTube is we're going to do a giveaway for all the people that have liked our page, subscribed to our page and stuff like that. So what we're going to do is we're going to give away a $25 Olive Garden gift card a $25 Red Lobster gift card a $25 Starbucks gift card and a $25 Texas Roadhouse gift card so when we when we do that what we're gonna do is we're gonna you're gonna have to like our Facebook page subscribe to our YouTube channel share the post that's going to be on it and tag two friends so when once you do that we'll put the description of what you actually need to do in the post but once you do that you can you can get entered to win one of these four gift cards if you want obviously this video is going to be out there and we're going to run this through YouTube so all you do is have to subscribe to our YouTube, share the post, tag two friends, and like our page. And then after about a week, Friday or Saturday, we'll put a deadline on it. We'll decide on a deadline. And once that's done, we'll pick the four winners. We'll reach out to you. If you're around the area, we'll bring you the cards. If not, we'll send them out to you and you can do whatever you want with them. Thanks guys and have a good day.

textual.observation: A giveaway offers four $25 restaurant gift cards, with entry tied to liking a Facebook page, subscribing to a YouTube channel, sharing a post, and tagging two friends.

evidence.quote: Giving away FOUR $25 gift cards to four random winners!
you're gonna have to like our Facebook page subscribe to our YouTube channel share the post that's going to be on it and tag two friends

textual.context: Presented by the speaker as promotion for the Two Tubs Facebook and YouTube pages; the supplied records describe a giveaway and its participation conditions.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised gift-card reward is explicitly linked to multiple audience-engagement actions and a winner-selection process, which may require later assessment of the promotion's terms and context.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the giveaway occurred, whether winners received cards, or whether payment, sensitive data, or other transfer was requested.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a giveaway of four $25 gift cards with entry conditions involving liking, subscribing, sharing, and tagging friends. The described frames show the speaker displaying gift cards, and there are no requests for money, sensitive personal data, or a separate deceptive transaction flow. The records do not establish whether winners were selected or received the cards.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an ordinary promotional giveaway: restaurant gift cards are offered as rewards, with entry conditioned on liking, subscribing, sharing and tagging friends. The supplied evidence does not show a purchase, payment, sensitive-data request, credential request or bypass mechanism.
